comment: Compatibility knowledge for compat levels/rules/check, sdk matrix, build compat, and triage installer-failure routing. Editable: rules drive the compat engine directly.

api_levels.name: KitKat Wear-only
api_levels.note: Wear-only API level; not a general phone target

api_levels.name: Pie
api_levels.note: Cleartext blocked by default; Apache HTTP client removed

api_levels.name: Android 10
api_levels.note: Scoped storage introduced; dark theme; TLS 1.3 default

api_levels.name: Android 11
api_levels.note: Scoped storage enforced for target 30; package visibility

api_levels.name: Android 12
api_levels.note: Explicit exported required; PendingIntent mutability; splash screens

api_levels.name: Android 14
api_levels.note: Foreground service types; receiver export flags; min installable target 23

api_levels.name: Android 16
api_levels.note: Newer levels: extend this file as platforms ship

behavior_rules.title: Runtime permission model
behavior_rules.impact: Dangerous permissions are granted at runtime, not at install.
behavior_rules.action: Check requestPermissions flows and permission-state handling for every dangerous permission in the manifest.

behavior_rules.title: FileUriExposedException for file:// URIs
behavior_rules.impact: Passing file:// URIs outside the app throws FileUriExposedException.
behavior_rules.action: Migrate to content:// URIs via FileProvider; scan for Uri.fromFile usage.

behavior_rules.title: network_security_config supported
behavior_rules.impact: Declarative TLS/cleartext policy becomes available and is the recommended control.
behavior_rules.action: Inspect res/xml network security config via: security scan <apk>.

behavior_rules.title: Background execution limits
behavior_rules.impact: Background services are stopped shortly after the app leaves the foreground.
behavior_rules.action: Convert background services to JobScheduler/WorkManager or foreground services with justification.

behavior_rules.title: Notification channels required
behavior_rules.impact: Notifications without a channel are not shown.
behavior_rules.action: Verify NotificationChannel creation for every notification path.

behavior_rules.title: Cleartext HTTP blocked by default
behavior_rules.impact: Plain HTTP traffic fails unless explicitly permitted.
behavior_rules.action: Prefer HTTPS; if legacy endpoints remain, add an explicit network security config domain exception and record the risk.

behavior_rules.title: Apache HTTP client removed from bootclasspath
behavior_rules.impact: org.apache.http classes are unavailable without a uses-library declaration.
behavior_rules.action: Add <uses-library android:name="org.apache.http.legacy"/> or migrate to HttpURLConnection/OkHttp.

behavior_rules.title: FOREGROUND_SERVICE permission required
behavior_rules.impact: startForegroundService without the permission throws SecurityException.
behavior_rules.action: Declare android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE in the manifest.

behavior_rules.title: Scoped storage introduced
behavior_rules.impact: Direct external-storage file paths stop working under scoped storage; requestLegacyExternalStorage can temporarily opt out.
behavior_rules.action: Inventory external-storage paths; plan migration to MediaStore/SAF.

behavior_rules.title: Scoped storage enforced
behavior_rules.impact: requestLegacyExternalStorage is ignored for target 30+.
behavior_rules.action: Complete MediaStore/SAF migration; test file access paths on an API 30+ lane.

behavior_rules.title: Package visibility filtering
behavior_rules.impact: queryIntentActivities/getPackageInfo see fewer apps without <queries> declarations.
behavior_rules.action: Add <queries> elements for every package/interaction the app relies on.

behavior_rules.title: android:exported must be explicit
behavior_rules.impact: Components with intent filters fail to install without an explicit android:exported value.
behavior_rules.action: Run: security scan <apk> and set android:exported on every activity/service/receiver with intent filters.

behavior_rules.title: PendingIntent mutability flag required
behavior_rules.impact: PendingIntent without FLAG_IMMUTABLE or FLAG_MUTABLE throws IllegalArgumentException.
behavior_rules.action: Audit every PendingIntent creation site; default to FLAG_IMMUTABLE.

behavior_rules.title: Foreground service start restrictions
behavior_rules.impact: Starting foreground services from the background throws ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException.
behavior_rules.action: Use WorkManager/exemptable triggers; test background start paths.

behavior_rules.title: System splash screen
behavior_rules.impact: The system shows its own splash on cold start; custom splash activities may double-display.
behavior_rules.action: Adopt SplashScreen API or adjust themes.

behavior_rules.title: POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission
behavior_rules.impact: Notifications are suppressed until the user grants POST_NOTIFICATIONS.
behavior_rules.action: Request the permission before first critical notification; handle denial UX.

behavior_rules.title: Granular media permissions
behavior_rules.impact: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES/VIDEO/AUDIO replace READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE for media access.
behavior_rules.action: Update permission declarations and request flows.

behavior_rules.title: NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES permission
behavior_rules.impact: Wi-Fi scanning APIs require the new runtime permission instead of location.
behavior_rules.action: Declare and request NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES where Wi-Fi APIs are used.

behavior_rules.title: Foreground service types required
behavior_rules.impact: Each foreground service must declare a type and matching permission; wrong types throw on start.
behavior_rules.action: Add android:foregroundServiceType and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_* permissions per service.

behavior_rules.title: Context-registered receiver export flags
behavior_rules.impact: registerReceiver for non-system broadcasts requires RECEIVER_EXPORTED or RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED.
behavior_rules.action: Audit registerReceiver call sites and add the correct flag.

behavior_rules.title: Implicit intent restrictions
behavior_rules.impact: Implicit intents may not be delivered to non-exported components.
behavior_rules.action: Use explicit intents for internal components.

behavior_rules.title: Minimum installable target SDK
behavior_rules.impact: Android 14+ devices refuse to install apps targeting below API 23 (INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK).
behavior_rules.action: Raise targetSdk to at least 23; see triage installer KB for the failure code.

behavior_rules.title: Edge-to-edge enforced
behavior_rules.impact: Apps targeting 35 draw edge-to-edge on Android 15; legacy insets handling breaks layout.
behavior_rules.action: Apply window insets handling; test on an API 35 lane.

behavior_rules.title: Play 64-bit requirement
behavior_rules.impact: Apps with native code must ship a 64-bit ABI alongside 32-bit for Play distribution.
behavior_rules.action: Run: artifact abi <apk>; build genuine arm64-v8a libraries (binary-only conversion is impossible).

behavior_rules.title: 16 KB page-size support
behavior_rules.impact: From 2025-11-01, Play requires new apps and updates targeting Android 15+ to support 16 KB memory page devices.
behavior_rules.action: Run: artifact abi <apk> --page-size; rebuild native libraries with 16 KB ELF segment alignment.

behavior_rules.title: Play target API currency
behavior_rules.impact: Play requires new apps and updates to target a recent API level (API 35+ as of August 2025).
behavior_rules.action: Verify the current Play Console policy date, then raise targetSdk with the compat rules above.

behavior_rules.title: TLS 1.2 enabled by default
behavior_rules.impact: SSLSocket enables TLS 1.2 from API 21; older devices need explicit enablement.
behavior_rules.action: For minSdk < 21, enable TLS 1.2 explicitly or use a bundled provider.

behavior_rules.title: TLS 1.3 default
behavior_rules.impact: Android 10+ enables TLS 1.3 by default via Conscrypt.
behavior_rules.action: Test legacy servers against TLS 1.3 handshakes; pin protocol versions only when authorized.

behavior_rules.title: Deprecated TLS behavior on Android 9+
behavior_rules.impact: Some legacy cipher suites and renegotiation behaviors fail on modern devices.
behavior_rules.action: Capture handshake errors via triage analyze and openssl s_client adapter.

behavior_rules.title: Multi-process WebView
behavior_rules.impact: WebView runs renderer processes separately from API 24+; data directory sharing crashes.
behavior_rules.action: Use WebView.setDataDirectorySuffix for multi-process apps sharing WebView.

behavior_rules.title: WebView Safe Browsing
behavior_rules.impact: Known-dangerous URLs trigger onSafeBrowsingHit instead of loading.
behavior_rules.action: Handle Safe Browsing callbacks; test offline behavior.

behavior_rules.title: ART replaces Dalvik
behavior_rules.impact: Ahead-of-time/dex2oat behavior changes install time, storage footprint, and some reflection edge cases.
behavior_rules.action: Test install and first-run on API 21+ lanes; avoid Dalvik-specific assumptions.

behavior_rules.title: Large-screen layouts (12L)
behavior_rules.impact: Taskbar, letterboxing, and multi-resume affect layout assumptions.
behavior_rules.action: Test resizeable activity behavior on a large-screen lane.

behavior_rules.title: Exact alarm restrictions
behavior_rules.impact: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is user-revocable from API 31; denied by default for new target-34+ apps.
behavior_rules.action: Prefer inexact/setWindow alarms; use USE_EXACT_ALARM only for genuine alarm-clock/calendar apps.

behavior_rules.title: Play Billing Library currency
behavior_rules.impact: Play requires a supported Billing Library version for apps selling digital goods; old versions stop working against retired endpoints.
behavior_rules.action: Detect billing usage via: artifact dex <apk> --strings-filter billingclient; migrate to a current library version (verify current Play requirement).

behavior_rules.title: SafetyNet Attestation deprecated
behavior_rules.impact: SafetyNet Attestation is deprecated in favor of the Play Integrity API; the legacy endpoint is being retired.
behavior_rules.action: Detect usage via: artifact dex <apk> --strings-filter safetynet; plan Play Integrity migration for source-available apps.

behavior_rules.title: Per-app unknown-sources permission
behavior_rules.impact: From Android 8+, the global unknown-sources toggle is replaced by a per-app REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES grant.
behavior_rules.action: Guide users to the per-app install permission; do not bypass installer policy.

test_matrix_lanes.focus: Forward readiness including the 16 KB lane

agp_gradle_jdk.note: Legacy; jcenter-era repositories likely need migration

platforms.note: android.jar lanes cited by the catalog: 18, 21, 23, 26, 28, 29, 30, 31, 33, 34, 35 and newer

build_tools.note: Keep a current release plus authorized legacy 28.x/30.x lanes for old pipelines

ndk.legacy_note: Projects affected by removed GNU STL need r16/r17 archives kept under version pins

system_images.arm64_note: ARM64 lanes only where host support exists; never presented as full-speed device parity

INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK.cause: Device API below manifest minSdkVersion, or target below the device minimum installable level (23 on Android 14+).
INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK.fix: Raise minSdk coverage with splits, or rebuild with a lower minSdk after compatibility review.

INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE.cause: Existing installation is signed with a different certificate.
INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE.evidence: artifact signing comparison between installed and new APK
INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE.fix: Sign with the original identity or an authorized rotation path; otherwise uninstall first (data loss - approval required).

INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE.evidence: versionCode from artifact pkginfo vs device dumpsys package
INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE.fix: Raise versionCode or uninstall the newer build with approval.

INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS.cause: No native library ABI supported by the device.
INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS.evidence: artifact abi listing vs device ro.product.cpu.abilist
INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS.fix: Package the required ABI; never claim 64-bit without a genuine tested arm64-v8a library.

INSTALL_FAILED_MISSING_SPLIT.cause: Required split APK missing from an install-multiple set.
INSTALL_FAILED_MISSING_SPLIT.evidence: package splits-resolve plan vs attempted install set
INSTALL_FAILED_MISSING_SPLIT.fix: Install the full resolved split set or a universal APK.

INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION.cause: Custom permission already defined by another package with a different signature.
INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION.fix: Rename the custom permission or align signing identity.

INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE.cause: Not enough free storage for install footprint.
INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE.evidence: device storage vs APK size and extractNativeLibs behavior
INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE.fix: Free space or reduce package footprint (see artifact inventory size report).

INSTALL_FAILED_INVALID_APK.evidence: artifact zip-health and artifact detect output
INSTALL_FAILED_INVALID_APK.fix: Repair the archive from a preserved original; re-run health checks.

INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_NO_CERTIFICATES.cause: APK has no v1 signature and the device requires one (pre-API 24 behavior).
INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_NO_CERTIFICATES.fix: Add a v1 (JAR) signature alongside v2/v3 for legacy lanes.

INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_INCONSISTENT_CERTIF.cause: Multiple signer certificates in META-INF do not match.
INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_INCONSISTENT_CERTIF.fix: Re-sign with a single consistent identity.

INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_MANIFEST_MALFORMED.cause: Manifest violates rules (e.g., missing android:exported at target 31+, bad component names).
INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_MANIFEST_MALFORMED.evidence: artifact axml dump and security scan exported audit
INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_MANIFEST_MALFORMED.fix: Repair the manifest fields flagged by the scan, then rebuild.

INSTALL_FAILED_PERMISSION_MODEL_DOWNGRAD.cause: Reinstalling a package that previously had permissions the new model revokes.
INSTALL_FAILED_PERMISSION_MODEL_DOWNGRAD.fix: Uninstall then install with approval; data loss must be authorized.

INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED.fix: Use an authorized device profile; never bypass device management.

INSTALL_FAILED_TEST_ONLY.cause: APK marked testOnly without the install flag.
INSTALL_FAILED_TEST_ONLY.fix: Install with -t on authorized test devices or rebuild without testOnly.

INSTALL_FAILED_CPU_ABI_INCOMPATIBLE.cause: Legacy ABI incompatibility on native libraries.
INSTALL_FAILED_CPU_ABI_INCOMPATIBLE.evidence: artifact abi and artifact elf machine fields
INSTALL_FAILED_CPU_ABI_INCOMPATIBLE.fix: Rebuild native libraries for a supported ABI.

INSTALL_FAILED_MISSING_FEATURE.cause: Device lacks a uses-feature marked required.
INSTALL_FAILED_MISSING_FEATURE.fix: Mark the feature not required if genuinely optional.

INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER.cause: Content provider authority already registered by another package.

INSTALL_FAILED_SHARED_USER_INCOMPATIBLE.cause: sharedUserId mismatch with existing shared-user packages.
INSTALL_FAILED_SHARED_USER_INCOMPATIBLE.fix: Align signing identity or drop sharedUserId (migration required).

INSTALL_FAILED_ABORTED.cause: User or policy cancelled the install prompt.
INSTALL_FAILED_ABORTED.fix: Retry on an authorized device with user consent.
